newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends slightly higher vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends slightly higher vs dollar.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended 40 centavos higher against the dollar at 1,063.60 in trading that saw it win modest support from traditional month-end dollar selling by banks, interbank dealers said.
"With the end of the month drawing near some big banks were out selling dollars," one dealer said, adding that the selling was to avoid government charges against their foreign exchange positions.
Some dollar-selling also reportedly came from the corporate sector.
Dealers reported a total of $161 million in trading and said the peso held in a 1,060-to-1,066.70 range.
